description: Personal build of HushFacebook 0.17.0 (95 patches) for Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 (com.facebook.katana, arm64-v8a bundle). Based on SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook (GPL-3.0), plus: the Following / most-recent feed is the home feed by default. Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK.
